title: Why Be Still?
question: What truth about God lets us stop striving and rest, even when nations rage and the earth shakes?
blurb: A command to be still in the middle of chaos - and the reason it's possible: God Himself.

nodes.content: What truth about God lets us stop striving and rest, even when nations rage and the earth shakes?

nodes.verseText: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”
For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence—but you were not willing.”
